arStrings.szText: {icon:bullet,1.2} Casting a {c_important}Grenade{/c} or {c_important}Trap{/c} Skill triggers a cluster of exploding {c_important}Stun Grenades{/c} that deal {c_number}[(Owner.Weapon_Damage_Min_Total + Owner.Weapon_Damage_Delta_Total) * Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} total Physical damage and Stun enemies for {c_number}[PowerTag.Rogue_Grenades."Script Formula 2"|2|]{/c} second. Enemies hit by {c_important}Stun Grenades{/c} take {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"|%x|]{/c} increased damage from your {c_important}Grenade{/c} and {c_important}Trap{/c} Skills for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 3"]{/c} seconds.
